title: Misoprostol With And Without Transcervical Balloon Catheter In Second Trimester Termination Of Pregnancy
brief_summary: This randomized controlled study will be performed to compare the benefits and risks associated with the administration of misoprostol with or without the use of a transcervical balloon catheter to terminate pregnancy in the second trimester (defined as gestational age between 14 and 28 weeks of gestation).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: pregnancy in the second trimester (defined as gestational age between 14 and 28 weeks of gestation) with a medical indication for termination of pregnancy.
